test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
'A @ B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the father of B'.

'A # B' means 'B is the son of A'.

If K # L & M @ N # P, then how is P related to K?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

Statement given : **K # L & M @ N # P**

Explanation :

 
• K # L → L is the son of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5be4fdd421e358e468a34d6813f10955ea4efec1770d19b6b5824fc449b3525.png] ​

 
• L & M → L is the father of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7c52ca66288a625c766a9826a3f8ebbffd2871fe349252a26a9abb77b901bd.png] ​

 
• M @ N → M is the husband of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83ac7a6b4eac5a8f8ebe784e5e1b505b4198435dccbd3cfa4c515a42290eb0c.png] ​

 
• N # P → P is the son of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22e48257c31df83a62bb291e2c849d34433043ed5c28d8ebefc10dc347f859f.png] ​

Thus, from the final family tree P is the son's son's son of K.

Hence, **"Son's son's son**" is the correct answer.
